title: Test your Azure data lake basics
guideLabel: Re-read what an Azure data lake is

questions.q: A colleague asks, 'Is Azure Data Lake Storage its own separate service?' What is the best answer?
options: Yes, it is a stand-alone product with its own account type
No, it is a set of extra features on normal Blob Storage, switched on by one setting
Yes, but only inside Microsoft Fabric
No, it is just another name for Power BI
questions.explain: Microsoft describes it as capabilities that you turn on for a storage account by enabling the hierarchical namespace. It builds on Blob Storage rather than replacing it.

questions.q: A friend asks, 'Is Azure a data warehouse or a data lake?' Which reply is fairest?
options: Both, because Azure is a cloud that sells lake services and warehouse services
questions.explain: Azure is not one tool. Storage services such as ADLS Gen2 act as the lake, while SQL-based services such as Synapse dedicated pools or Fabric Data Warehouse act as warehouses.

questions.q: What does the hierarchical namespace give you?
options: Real folders and sub-folders, so renaming a folder is one quick step
Free storage for the first year
Automatic copies of your data in every country
questions.explain: It lets you organise files into directories like on your own computer. Renaming or deleting a directory becomes a single operation instead of touching every file.

questions.q: Which statement about the engine you pick on top of the lake is the most accurate?
options: The storage and the engine are always the same product
You can only ever use one engine on one lake
The lake keeps the files and an engine reads them, so engines can change
Engines store your files, so changing engines means starting over
questions.explain: A lake is storage plus processing. The files stay in storage, and an engine such as Synapse, Databricks or Fabric reads them, which is why teams can move between engines.
